svg.title: Elevations — R06 TL1 attached toilet
svg.desc: Read-only interior elevations from the canonical master; HD-11 levels are homeowner-stated or derived and unmeasured; wall names by compass.
svg.text: Interior elevations — R06 TL1 attached toilet
8 ft 9 in x 5 ft 6 in · every wall seen from inside · named by compass · HD-11 levels unmeasured

g.text: Standing inside, looking SOUTH · left to right
• Vanity 0.20–0.85 m, basin top 0.92 m, faucet 1.06 m; mirror 0.55 × 0.8 m
centred at 1.55 m. WC cistern to 1.00 m, seat 0.43 m (dashed). All
fixture dimensions are proposed, not site measured.
• Shower: head 2.15 m, mixer 1.05 m, glass screen 2.00 m. These are
proposed dimensions, not site measured. Kit-kat tile only on this faucet
wall inside the shower; plain porcelain elsewhere.
Standing inside, looking WEST · left to right
• V01 TL1 vent / window: 1000 mm wide, sill 1.90 m, head 2.30 m
• SN1 TL1 shower niche: 750 mm wide, sill 0.95 m, head 1.30 m (sill/head
• Shower niche 0.75 × 0.35 m, 120 mm deep, centred 1.13 m: proposed
model dimensions, not site measured. No new cutting without
professional approval. Kit-kat covers this wet-area wall except the
Standing inside, looking NORTH · left to right
Standing inside, looking EAST · left to right
• D04 TL1 door: 799 mm wide, head 2.13 m (sill/head assumed).

svg.text: HEIGHTS (HD-11, all unmeasured): the 11 ft floor-to-floor (3.353 m) and ~9 in (0.229 m) band drop are homeowner-stated; the band underside 2.959 m and slab underside 3.188 m are derived from them (5 in slab and 1.5 in finish assumed).

The raised centre is a separate gypsum/POP panel below the slab (HD-14); its level and cavity depth are unmeasured, and 3.19 m is only the slab-underside reference plane. Bathrooms 2.40 m, utility 2.95 m, lobby and balcony levels were
not provided (placeholders). Window and door heads are assumptions. Nothing is as-built.
Drawn south-up (not rotated): sheet-top = SOUTH (utility/washing), sheet-bottom = NORTH (entrance/balcony), sheet-left = EAST (kitchen/dining/living), sheet-right = WEST (bedrooms).

Compass: approximate homeowner north, recorded in the master (visualization_geometry.orientation): entrance/balcony/stairs face NORTH. Cardinal directions only — true bearing and magnetic declination are not surveyed.

† marks an opening that is assumed, a placeholder, centred-but-unmeasured, or (PN1) a built niche whose size is unmeasured. Window and door positions are modelled plan positions, not site verified; sills and heads are assumptions.

Held items (red dashed) are not approved layouts. The 2.939 m children’s curtain top is an assumed HD-11 drawing level, not measured hardware. Living, master and children’s concealed curtain pockets need two tracks (sheer + blackout,
HD-14); their clear sizes are unverified.

Dimensions in metres unless marked mm. Wall names are compass directions; the small sheet tags (e.g. master-s) are only drawing IDs. Items without a height in the master are shown as footprints below the floor line.
REVIEW DRAFT · read-only drawing from the canonical master · not a construction release · unmeasured levels and sizes marked
